name: Isras Holdings Ltd
summary: Isras Holdings Ltd engages in the real estate business in Israel. The company operates in two segments, Income-Producing Real Estate and Residential and For-Sale Real Estate. The Income producing real estate segment engages in initiating, planning, establishing, and managing rental projects for trade and services. The Residential and for-sale real estate segment is involved in improvement and sale of land designated for residential buildings. Isras Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
